governance_body: Abu Dhabi Public Health Center (ADPHC) & DoH Abu Dhabi

rules.recommended_action: Schedule comprehensive Well-Child developmental and clinical assessment
rules.clinical_rationale: Periodic developmental surveillance, anthropometric growth tracking, and sensory assessment are mandated by ADPHC Well-Child Standard.

rules.recommended_action: Administer age-appropriate mandatory National Immunization Program vaccines
rules.clinical_rationale: Timely immunization prevents vaccine-preventable pediatric morbidity and complies with UAE Federal Law No. 3 (Wadeema's Law).
rules.source_guideline: UAE National Immunization Program & Wadeema's Law
